scripts.text: My family, the MacMillan Clan, has been producing Professional Traffic Signal Posts for more than 250 years. Nowadays, we are booking Special Orders for our unique ornament, ^3355FFStop Post^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們麥克米蘭家族生產專業交通標誌已有250多年。如今，我們接受特別訂單，定製獨特的飾品——停^3355FF車標誌頭^000000飾。
我可以訂購一^3355FF個停車標誌頭^000000飾嗎？

scripts.text: This unique ornament, ^3355FFStop Post^000000, is a traffic signal on the road, and doubles as a hair ornament! This, we solemnly promise on the strength of a 100-year guarantee.
scripts.translation: 這款獨特的^3355FF停車標誌^000000頭飾既是路上的交通標誌，也是一件髮飾！我們鄭重承諾，提供100年保修。

scripts.text: To produce a ^3355FFStop Post^000000, we need ^3355FF91100 Zeny^000000, ^3355FF50 Trunk^000000 and ^3355FF1 Black Dyestuffs^000000.
When you get those items, swing on by and we'll give you a Stop Post.
scripts.translation: 準備好材料後就過來，我們會給您一個停車標誌頭飾。

scripts.text: Anyway, thank you for coming by 'MacMillan's Workshop.' But think about buying something next time, will ya?
scripts.translation: 總之，感謝您光臨“麥克米蘭工坊”。下次也請考慮買點東西，好嗎？

scripts.text: I know what you're gonna talk about. You want the Magic Glasses from me, riiiiight?
scripts.translation: 我知道你要說什麼。你是想從我這裡買魔法眼鏡，對吧？

scripts.text: Well, the official name for them is ^3355FFBinoculars^000000! An optical device that works like a pair of field glasses, they're designed for simultaneous use by both eyes!
scripts.translation: 它們的正式名稱是望^3355FF遠鏡！這^000000是一種像雙筒望遠鏡一樣的光學裝置，設計用於雙眼同時使用！

scripts.text: They're made up of two small telescopes joined with a single focusing device. You can arrange the lenses to produce stereoscopic vision.
scripts.translation: 它由兩個小望遠鏡和一個單一的調焦裝置組成。你可以調整鏡片以產生立體視覺。
你似乎不相信我剛才說的話？拜託，
我會告訴你我需要的材料.

scripts.text: Now my masterpiece will be complete!
scripts.translation: 現在我的傑作就要完成了！

scripts.text: Don't peep at something you shouldn't look at. Well, at least try not to.
scripts.translation: 不要窺視你不該看的東西。好吧，至少試著別這麼做。

scripts.text: Now you're in front of Marius, an Alchemist among Alchemists. Ignoring me, eh? Come on, I'll beat your ass!
scripts.translation: 現在你站在馬裡烏斯面前了，我可是鍊金術士中的鍊金術士。無視我，是吧？來吧，我要揍扁你！

scripts.text: Excuse me, but may I ask

scripts.translation: 請問可以問你一個問題嗎？

scripts.text: Eh? Oh, I'm sorry, I was

scripts.translation: 我剛才太專心看這本書了！

scripts.text: Ah! This is one of the best sellers of Joshua Vansei's.
scripts.translation: 啊！這是約書亞·範賽的暢銷書之一。

scripts.text: The main character is a writer, and it's so touching that this guy writes a story of his mistress...
scripts.translation: 主角是一位作家，故事非常感人，講述了他和情人的故事...

scripts.text: Oh.. I can't wait to see Hoein Special..
scripts.translation: 哦...我迫不及待想看看《赫因特輯》了。

scripts.text: And this, you could have a look if you want to.
scripts.translation: 還有這本，如果你感興趣的話可以看看。

scripts.text: Looks like the cover's rounded with a red strap,
scripts.translation: 看起來封面是用紅色絲帶綁著的，這.

scripts.text: which..I really think is for adults only.
Haah... Guess it's good to be living, after all.
Who would've thought to actually see the Satan while alive.....?
scripts.translation: 誰能想到在活著的時候真的看到了魔王呢...？

scripts.text: Oh, the world.. the world is doomed..
Nothing seems to be working now..
scripts.translation: 現在似乎什麼都行不通了...

scripts.text: Good heavens.. I can't believe this young girl's drinking with sadness....
scripts.translation: 天哪...我簡直不敢相信這個年輕女孩在悲傷中喝酒...

scripts.text: No commoners are allowed in the area beyond this point.
This place is extremely dangerous so you are restricted from entering.
scripts.translation: 這裡極其危險，因此禁止進入。

scripts.text: Didn't you know? Satan Morocc has resurrected and broke out of Morocc Village where he was confined.
scripts.translation: 你不知道嗎？魔王夢羅克復活了，並打破了將他囚禁的夢羅克村莊。

scripts.text: His resurrection has caused irreparable damage to the village and to the desert around it, and now he has moved to the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation: 他的復活給村莊和周圍的沙漠造成了無法彌補的破壞，現在他已轉移到蘇克拉特沙漠。

scripts.text: We are here to carry out the orders of the Prontera Kingdom by preventing commoners, aside from the members of the Morocc Subjugation, from accessing the area.
scripts.translation: 我們在此執行普隆德拉王國的命令，阻止平民（夢羅克鎮壓小組成員除外）進入該區域。

scripts.text: If you'd like to know more information, I suggest that you speak to the Continental Guard in charge of the accident site in Morocc Village.
scripts.translation: 如果您想了解更多資訊，建議您與負責夢羅克村莊事故現場的皇家衛士對話。

scripts.text: The guard that you want to talk to is at a camp built in the center of Morocc Village.
scripts.translation: 您想交談的衛兵在夢羅克村莊中心搭建的營地。

scripts.text: If you'd like, I can send you there directly.
scripts.translation: 如果您願意，我可以直接送您去那裡。

scripts.text: I see. Well then, for your safety, please leave this dangerous area as soon as possible.
scripts.translation: 明白了。那麼，為了您的安全，請儘快離開這個危險區域。

scripts.text: Great. I'll send you to Morocc Village's accident site shortly.
scripts.translation: 好的。我馬上送您去夢羅克村莊的事故現場。

scripts.text: No commoners are allowed in the area beyond this point.
This place is extremely dangerous so you are restricted from entering.
scripts.translation: 這裡極其危險，因此禁止進入。

scripts.text: Yes, I've confirmed that you're a member of the Continental Guards. I wish you good luck in accomplishing your mission.
scripts.translation: 是的，我已確認您是皇家衛士的成員。祝您任務順利。

scripts.text: I'll send you to the field shortly. Please use the warp at the field entrance to come back to this area.
scripts.translation: 我馬上送您去野外。請使用野外入口的傳送點返回此區域。

scripts.text: Welcome, members of the Continental Guards. I have a special order from Chief Balrog for you, so let me read it for you.
scripts.translation: 歡迎，皇家衛士的成員們。我有一封來自巴洛格隊長的特別命令，讓我為您宣讀一下。

scripts.text: 'Due to the dangers of this area, I hereby prohibit members of the Continental Guard to investigate the area alone. You must organize a party of at least 2 members to carry out your missions from now on.'
scripts.translation: “鑑於該區域的危險性，我在此禁止皇家衛士成員單獨調查該區域。從現在起，你們必須組建至少2名成員的隊伍來執行任務。”

scripts.text: ...You understand that, right? Please go back to the site, and come back in a party of at least 2 members. Thank you.
scripts.translation: ...您明白了嗎？請返回現場，並組建至少2名成員的隊伍再來。謝謝。

scripts.text: Only members of the Continental Guards with Continental Guard Certificates are allowed to proceed beyond this point.
scripts.translation: 只有持有皇家衛士證書的皇家衛士成員才能通過此處。

scripts.text: We've received orders from Headquarters to block access to this area since an unusual space-time phenomenon has been detected from the Morocc field.
scripts.translation: 我們收到總部的命令，由於在夢羅克野外檢測到異常時空現象，封鎖了該區域的入口。

scripts.text: We need to wait until the phenomenon is over, and then we'll let you proceed with your investigation.
scripts.translation: 我們需要等待現象結束，然後才會允許您繼續調查。

scripts.text: Great. I'll send you to Morocc Village's accident site shortly.
scripts.translation: 好的。我馬上送您去夢羅克村莊的事故現場。

scripts.text: Ah, you're an adventurer working for the Continental Guard. Nice to meet you. Feel free to ask me if you need my assistance.
scripts.translation: 啊，您是受僱於皇家衛士的冒險者。很高興見到您。如果您需要幫助，請隨時問我。

scripts.text: Enter the First Field to Investigate
scripts.translation: 進入第一野外進行調查

scripts.text: Enter the Second Field to Investigate
scripts.translation: 進入第二野外進行調查

scripts.translation: 這裡極其危險，因此禁止進入。

scripts.text: Good day, {0}. We don't have the luxury of time in this dire situation so I'll try to make this quick.
scripts.translation: 您好，{0}。在這種危急情況下，我們沒有太多時間，所以我儘量長話短說。

scripts.text: I'm a messenger dispatched here to {0} from the Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters. My duty is to deliver this important message to as many renowned adventurers as I can. I'm glad that I was finally able to find you, {1}.
scripts.translation: 我是從夢羅克皇家衛{0}士總部派往的信使。我的職責是將這份重要訊息傳達給儘可能多的知名冒險者。很高興我終於找到了您，{1}。

scripts.text: Time's running out, so I can only give you a brief explanation.
scripts.translation: 時間緊迫，我只能簡單說明一下情況。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc, the heinous demon imprisoned deep in Morocc's underground for centuries, has resurrected and broken free.
scripts.translation: 被囚禁在夢羅克地下深處的魔王夢羅克，已經復活並掙脫了封印。

scripts.text: The revival of Satan Morocc has completely devastated Morocc Village and the area surrounding it.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克的復活，徹底摧毀了夢羅克村莊及其周邊地區。

scripts.text: All of the death and suffering... Anywhere else must seem like heaven compared to what's happening in and around Morocc.
scripts.translation: 死亡與痛苦蔓延...與夢羅克發生的一切相比，其他地方簡直如同天堂。

scripts.text: The Morocc Continental Guard was immediately organized to fight Satan Morocc and bring relief to this dire situation. I'm here to inform everyone in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom about this catastrophe.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克皇家衛士已迅速組建，以對抗魔王夢羅克並緩解這一危急局勢。我在此是為了向盧恩·米德加茲王國的所有人通報這場災難。

scripts.text: We need your help, {0}. We need reputable adventurers like you to seal away Satan Morocc once again.
scripts.translation: 我們需要您的幫助{0}，。我們需要像您這樣聲譽卓著的冒險者，再次將魔王夢羅克封印起來。

scripts.text: For more information, please speak to the captain of the Morocc Continental Guard. He is waiting for you, {0}.
scripts.translation: 如需瞭解更多詳情，請與夢羅克皇家衛士的隊長對話。他正在等您，{0}。

scripts.text: The Continental Guard Headquarters is located near the center palace of Morocc, so please go speak to the chief as soon as you can.
scripts.translation: 皇家衛士總部位於夢羅克中央宮殿附近，請儘快去與隊長對話。

scripts.text: I'm a messenger from the Morocc Continental Guards Headquarters, and I've come here to {0} with an urgent message for everyone here in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 我是夢羅克皇家衛士總部的信使，我帶著緊急訊息來到{0}，要傳達給盧恩·米德加茲王國的所有人。

scripts.translation: 夢羅克皇家衛士已迅速組建，以對抗魔王夢羅克並緩解這一危急局勢。我在此是為了向盧恩·米德加茲王國的所有人通報這場災難。

scripts.text: Part of my duty is to help recruit adventurers from around the world to help drive Satan Morocc back into confinement. It won't be easy, but he was defeated once before. Satan Morocc can be sealed away again.
scripts.translation: 我的職責之一是招募世界各地的冒險者，協助將魔王夢羅克重新封印。這並不容易，但他曾被擊敗過。魔王夢羅克是可以再次被封印的。

scripts.text: At least 70% of Morocc Village was destroyed by the fallout of Satan Morocc's resurrection.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克村莊至少有70%的區域因魔王夢羅克的復活而遭到破壞。

scripts.text: The desert around Morocc has also turned into a land of death after it was claimed by Satan Morocc and his powerful doppelgangers and underlings.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克周邊的沙漠也因魔王夢羅克及其強大的分身和手下而變成了死亡之地。

scripts.text: So heed my warning, stay away from the Morocc area unless you're on a mission organized by the Morocc Continental Guard.
scripts.translation: 因此請聽從我的警告，除非是執行夢羅克皇家衛士組織的任務，否則請遠離夢羅克地區。

scripts.text: Ah, very well. I have an extremely important message for you.
scripts.translation: 啊，很好。我有一條極其重要的訊息要告訴您。

scripts.text: The situation is urgent, so please listen to me carefully.
scripts.translation: 情況緊急，請仔細聽我說。

scripts.text: On behalf of the Continental Guard, I thank you for your efforts. Now, let me see if I've received any news from Headquarters that you should know...
scripts.translation: 代表皇家衛士，感謝您的付出。現在，讓我看看是否收到了您應該知道的總部訊息...

scripts.text: Nothing yet. Please carry on with your current mission. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation: 還沒有訊息。請繼續執行您當前的任務。再次感謝您。

scripts.text: Welcome to the Morocc Subjugation Information Center. How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 歡迎來到夢羅克討伐資訊中心。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me about the village situation.
I'm stationed here to assist adventurers who wish to volunteer and help the Continental Guard fight Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 我駐守在此，協助那些希望志願加入皇家衛士，共同對抗魔王夢羅克的冒險者。

scripts.text: I am sure you are already aware that Satan Morocc's revival threatens the peace of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom, and if Satan Morocc is allowed to roam free, it will devour the entire world.
scripts.translation: 我想您應該已經知道，魔王夢羅克的復活威脅著盧恩·米德加茲王國的和平。如果任由魔王夢羅克肆虐，它將吞噬整個世界。

scripts.text: The Continental Guard is currently planning an array of countermeasures to suppress Satan Morocc under the order of the kingdom.
scripts.translation: 皇家衛士目前正在王國的命令下，制定一系列對策以鎮壓魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text: If you have been invited by our messenger, or are confident in your skills, we encourage you to volunteer for the Continental Guards and bring peace back to this continent.
scripts.translation: 如果您收到了我們信使的邀請，或者對自己的實力有信心，我們鼓勵您志願加入皇家衛士，為這片大陸帶來和平。

scripts.text: Welcome, {0}. I've been waiting for you. I assume our messenger informed you of our situation.
scripts.translation: 歡迎，{0}。我一直在等您。我想我們的信使已經向您說明了當前的情況。

scripts.text: Let me process your application immediately. Please wait.
scripts.translation: 讓我立即為您辦理申請手續。請稍等。

scripts.text: Now please go speak to Chief Balrog of the Continental Guard. You can find him in the center.
scripts.translation: 現在請去與皇家衛士的巴洛格隊長對話。您可以在中央找到他。

scripts.text: I applaud you for your courage, but you will need more than just courage to help us.
scripts.translation: 我欽佩您的勇氣，但僅憑勇氣還不足以幫助我們。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc is most powerful evil that exists in the mortal world. Snuffing out your life would be so trivial to him.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克是凡間最強大的邪惡存在。對他來說，取走你的性命易如反掌。

scripts.text: I strongly recommend that you just think about your own safety for now. When the final battle comes, I am sure that no place will be safe.
scripts.translation: 我強烈建議您現在先考慮自己的安全。當最終決戰來臨時，我相信沒有任何地方是安全的。

scripts.text: As you can see, the situation can't be worse. The village and the surrounding area were irreparably damaged by Satan Morocc's resurrection.
scripts.translation: 如您所見，情況已經糟糕透頂。村莊及周邊地區因魔王夢羅克的復活而遭受了無法修復的破壞。

scripts.text: Since the kingdom has dispatched Continental Guard Messengers everywhere, many able adventurers have flocked to this place, but... I'm afraid they still might not be enough to defeat the demon.
scripts.translation: 由於王國已向各地派遣了皇家衛士信使，許多有能力的冒險者都聚集到了這裡，但...恐怕這仍然不足以擊敗惡魔。

scripts.text: Please follow our instructions, at least around this area, and stay out of danger for now.
scripts.translation: 請遵循我們的指示，至少在這個區域內，暫時遠離危險。

scripts.text: Your application already has been registered. Please go speak to Chief Balrog.
scripts.translation: 您的申請已經登記完畢。請去與巴洛格隊長對話。

scripts.text: You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation: 您來得不是時候，但很高興見到您。我是皇家衛士的巴洛格隊長。我們被派往夢羅克以鎮壓魔王夢羅克...我們需要聚集所有能找到的力量和運氣。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy checking through all these applications for future Continental Guards to greet you adventurers one by one.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙著稽核這些未來皇家衛士的申請，沒空逐一問候各位冒險者。

scripts.text: Listen, it might be more helpful if you talk to some other people first. I'm sure one of the other Continental Guards or our messengers will be better equipped to help you out.
scripts.translation: 聽著，也許先和其他人聊聊會更有幫助。我相信其他皇家衛士成員或我們的信使能更好地為您提供幫助。

scripts.text: You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation: 您來得不是時候，但很高興見到您。我是皇家衛士的巴洛格隊長。我們被派往夢羅克以鎮壓魔王夢羅克...我們需要聚集所有能找到的力量和運氣。

scripts.text: It looks like you have business with me. Please make it brief since I don't have a lot of time on my hands. There's lots of things I need to take care of...
scripts.translation: 看來您有正事找我。請長話短說，因為我手頭有很多事情要處理，時間很緊...
詢問關於皇家衛士的事

scripts.text: I want to join the Continental Guard.
The damage that Satan Morocc's resurrection has caused is obvious just by taking a look around this area.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克復活所造成的破壞，只要看看周圍的環境就一目瞭然。

scripts.text: What's scary is that all this was caused just by breaking out from it's prison. Just think of the damage it could do if it was left to roam around freely...
scripts.translation: 可怕的是，這一切僅僅是因為它掙脫了牢籠。想像一下，如果它被放任自由地四處遊蕩，會造成多大的破壞...

scripts.text: Morocc Village is completely devastated, and Satan Morocc has now claimed possession of the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克村莊已經徹底被毀，而魔王夢羅克現在佔據了蘇克拉特沙漠。

scripts.text: I've no doubt that if left unchecked, Satan Morocc will take over the entire Midgard Continent. We've got to stop him right now before the entire world suffers.
scripts.translation: 毫無疑問，如果不加阻止，魔王夢羅克將佔領整個米德加爾特大陸。我們必須在它給整個世界帶來災難之前，立刻阻止它。

scripts.text: That's why the kingdom has ordered us elite soldiers to form the Continental Guard, and recruit reputable adventurers around the world so that we can make a united stand against Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 因此，王國命令我們精英士兵組建皇家衛士，並招募世界各地的知名冒險者，以便我們聯合起來對抗魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text: Of course, it'll be incredibly difficult... We'll need to make sacrifices... I'm not even sure if we can win. Still, the fate of the world is at stake, and we've got to do something. Dark times have truly fallen upon us...
scripts.translation: 當然，這將極其困難...我們將不得不做出犧牲...我甚至不確定我們能否獲勝。儘管如此，世界的命運懸於一線，我們必須採取行動。黑暗的時代真的降臨了...

scripts.text: Huh? Do you want to join us and volunteer for the Continental Guard?
scripts.translation: 咦？你想加入我們，自願成為皇家衛士的一員嗎？

scripts.text: What was your name? {0}? Oh yes, I've heard of you.
scripts.translation: 你叫什麼名字？{0}？哦，是的，我聽說過你。

scripts.text: Hmm, it occurs to me that you don't understand the danger involved in all this. Do you have any idea how powerful Satan Morocc is?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我突然想到，你可能並不瞭解其中蘊含的危險。你知道魔王夢羅克有多強大嗎？

scripts.text: You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.
scripts.translation: 如果你不完全瞭解風險，就無法幫助我們。我見過成千上萬魯莽的冒險者，自以為憑一己之力就能擊敗魔王夢羅克，結果白白送命。

scripts.text: We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.
scripts.translation: 我們面對的是決定世界未來的威脅，那些無法團隊協作的傻瓜只會成為累贅，而不是助力。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，經驗不足的冒險者只會妨礙我們。希望你能理解。如果你真的想幫助我們，那麼請暫時專注於提升自己的實力。

scripts.text: Look, I understand your enthusiasm, but you're mistaken if you think you can help us. I don't have time to fully explain the danger that we're all facing.
scripts.translation: 聽著，我理解你的熱情，但如果你認為你能幫上忙，那就大錯特錯了。我沒有時間詳細解釋我們所有人面臨的危險。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc is nothing like the monsters you may have encountered. At best you'll throw your life away, but there's the chance that you might get one of my men killed by your mistakes and incompetence. I can't have that!
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克與你可能遇到的魔物完全不同。最好的情況是你白白送命，但更糟糕的是，你的失誤和無能可能會導致我的部下喪命。我不能讓這種事發生！

scripts.text: Please understand that this is for your own good. Fight some Porings or whatever else might be a good match for your level.
scripts.translation: 請理解，這是為你好。去和波利或其他適合你等級的魔物戰鬥吧。

scripts.text: You've just got to let me join!
Sigh... Why are you so persistent? Can't you understand that no means no? Let me say this one more time.
scripts.translation: 唉...你為什麼這麼執著？難道不明白“不”就是“不”嗎？讓我再說最後一次。

scripts.text: We're too busy fighting Satan Morocc to watch after rookies like you. You'd just be throwing your life away.
scripts.translation: 我們正忙著對抗魔王夢羅克，沒空照顧像你這樣的新人。你只會白白送命。

scripts.text: Stop bothering me. You'd be nothing but a burden.
scripts.translation: 別煩我了。你只會成為累贅。

scripts.text: Give me a chance to prove myself!
scripts.translation: 給我一個證明自己的機會！

scripts.text: Huh? You want a chance to prove yourself?
scripts.translation: 哈？你想證明自己的實力？

scripts.text: Yes, I'll do whatever it takes to join the Continental Guard!
scripts.translation: 是的，為了加入皇家衛士，我願意付出任何代價！

scripts.text: Interesting. You have my attention. Alright, I guess it's only fair that I acknowledge your strength if you can handle something for me.
scripts.translation: 有意思。你引起了我的注意。好吧，既然你如此堅持，如果你能幫我完成一件事，我就承認你的實力。

scripts.text: The Continental Guard has been on full alert around this village and the desert. We need to be prepared in case Satan Morocc storms our defenses.
scripts.translation: 皇家衛士在這個村莊和沙漠周圍處於全面警戒狀態。我們需要做好準備，以防魔王夢羅克突襲我們的防線。

scripts.text: Soldiers need firewood to keep the bonfires burning all night, but we've been suffering a firewood shortage.
scripts.translation: 士兵們需要柴火來整夜燃燒篝火，但我們一直面臨柴火短缺的問題。

scripts.text: I happened to hear that the monsters in the Lava Dungeon have everlasting flame which would solve our bonfire problems. I want you to gather those flames for us.
scripts.translation: 我聽說熔岩副本里的魔物擁有永恆之火，這能解決我們的篝火問題。我要你去為我們收集那些火焰。

scripts.text: That's too hard! Let me think about it!
Hmpf, I was right. I knew you wouldn't be able to handle such a simple task. I shouldn't have wasted my time with you.
scripts.translation: 哼，我就知道。我早就知道連這麼簡單的任務你都做不了。我不該在你身上浪費時間。

scripts.text: Excellent! Bring back ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000. I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation: 很好！帶回來^0000FF30火種。^000000我會在這裡等你回來。

scripts.text: What? How can you even think of joining us when you don't have any real skills to offer?
scripts.translation: 什麼？你沒有任何實際技能，怎麼敢想加入我們？

scripts.text: I guarantee that you'd just drag my soldiers down with you. You'd only be a threat to Satan Morocc in your dreams. Just give it up.
scripts.translation: 我敢保證，你只會拖累我計程車兵。你只能在夢裡威脅魔王夢羅克。還是放棄吧。

scripts.text: You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.
scripts.translation: 如果你不完全瞭解風險，就無法幫助我們。我見過成千上萬魯莽的冒險者，自以為憑一己之力就能擊敗魔王夢羅克，結果白白送命。

scripts.text: We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.
scripts.translation: 我們面對的是決定世界未來的威脅，那些無法團隊協作的傻瓜只會成為累贅，而不是助力。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，經驗不足的冒險者只會妨礙我們。希望你能理解。如果你真的想幫助我們，那麼請暫時專注於提升自己的實力。

scripts.text: So, did you find ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000? You didn't come empty-handed, did you?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你^0000FF找到30火種^000000了嗎？你不會空手而歸吧？

scripts.text: Let's see... One, two, three... Thirty, you've brought them all. Well, this was a pretty simple task. All it takes is time and a little effort. Anyone could do it.
scripts.translation: 讓我看看...一，二，三...三十，你都帶回來了。嗯，這確實是個簡單的任務。只需要一點時間和努力。誰都能做到。

scripts.text: Anyways, thank you for bringing the Live Coals. I guess you're stronger than I thought.
scripts.translation: 總之，謝謝你帶回了火種。看來你比我想像的更強。

scripts.text: Now will you let me join the Continental Guard?
scripts.translation: 現在你可以讓我加入皇家衛士了嗎？

scripts.text: No, gathering these flames is a piece of cake compared to what we're going to do.
scripts.translation: 不，收集這些火焰與我們即將要做的事情相比，簡直是小菜一碟。

scripts.text: I'm still not convinced that you're good enough to join us. Let me think... Hmm...
scripts.translation: 我仍然不確信你有足夠的實力加入我們。讓我想想... 嗯...

scripts.text: I didn't think you would accept me so easily. I'm ready. Ask me whatever you want.
scripts.translation: 沒想到你會這麼輕易地接受我。我準備好了。儘管問吧，問什麼都行。

scripts.text: Ah, I've got an idea. Now, because this is an allied operation, we've accepted some mercenary soldiers from the Schwarzwald Republic to join the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation: 啊，我有個主意。既然這是一次聯合行動，我們接納了一些來自秀髮茲發德共和國的傭兵加入皇家衛士。

scripts.text: These mercenaries have never seen the desert, and they're having trouble carrying out operations in the heat, dry air, and sandstorms. It's not their fault, but they could use a little help since they're out of their element.
scripts.translation: 這些傭兵從未見過沙漠，他們在炎熱、乾燥的空氣和沙塵暴中執行任務時遇到了困難。這不是他們的錯，但他們身處陌生環境，可能需要一點幫助。

scripts.text: (This guy seems threatening, but he seems to have a good heart.)
scripts.translation: (這傢伙看起來很有威脅性，但他似乎心地善良。)

scripts.text: Now, I remember hearing that the monsters in the Ice Cave to the north have frozen hearts. Those hearts might be able to relieve those soldiers from the heat.
scripts.translation: 我記得聽說北邊的冰洞裡的魔物擁有冰塊心臟。那些心臟或許能緩解那些士兵的炎熱。

scripts.text: No problem. How many do you want?
I knew that'd be too tough for you. I'm glad you finally realized your limits before it was too late. It takes wisdom to recognize your weakness.
scripts.translation: 我就知道這對你來說太難了。很高興你在為時已晚之前意識到了自己的極限。能認識到自己的弱點是一種智慧。

scripts.text: You'd better pack up and return where you came from. You want to be far away from here when Satan Morocc attacks.
scripts.translation: 你最好收拾好行囊，回到你來的地方。當魔王夢羅克進攻時，你最好離這裡遠遠的。

scripts.text: Huh?! Are you sure you can bring those? Hmm...
scripts.translation: 什麼？！你確定你能帶回來嗎？嗯...

scripts.text: Well... If you insist on giving it a try, then... I'll need at least 50 of those frozen hearts.
scripts.translation: 好吧... 如果你堅持要試試的話... 我至少需要50個冰塊心臟。

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FF50 Glacial Hearts^000000. The faster you get them here, the better.
scripts.translation: 請給我^0000FF帶50冰^000000塊心臟。越快越好。

scripts.text: Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 30 Live Coals, 30.
scripts.translation: 嗯... 你沒聽到我說的話嗎？我說的是30個火種，30個。

scripts.text: Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!
scripts.translation: 現在快點去吧。如果你想放棄，沒關係。但請告訴我！

scripts.text: So, did you find 50 Glacial Hearts?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你找到50個冰塊心臟了嗎？

scripts.text: Thank you. I'm sure that my soldiers will appreciate these... Those guys aren't used to the desert, and could use the relief.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。我相信我計程車兵們會感激這些... 那些傢伙不習慣沙漠，需要這些來緩解炎熱。

scripts.text: Well... It looks like you earned this.
scripts.translation: 嗯... 看來你確實贏得了這個。

scripts.text: You'd know if you read it. It's a certificate that proves that you're a member of the Continental Guard. I admit that I'm impressed by your skills and gumption.
scripts.translation: 如果你讀一下就會知道。這是一張證明你是皇家衛士成員的證書。我承認，你的技能和勇氣讓我印象深刻。

scripts.text: Welcome to the Continental Guard, my friend. Are you ready to risk your life for the sake of peace in the world?
scripts.translation: 歡迎加入皇家衛士，我的朋友。你準備好為了世界的和平而獻出生命了嗎？

scripts.text: Your mission from here on will be simple, but extremely difficult: you will join the rest of the Continental Guard to keep Satan Morocc from fully reviving its true power.
scripts.translation: 從今以後，你的任務很簡單，但極其困難：你將加入皇家衛士，阻止魔王夢羅克完全恢復其真正的力量。

scripts.text: My soldiers are risking their lives to fight Morocc's doppelgangers and underlings in order to make it safer for their comrades to travel to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation: 我計程車兵們正冒著生命危險，與夢羅克的分身和手下戰鬥，以便讓他們的同志能更安全地前往夢羅克的巢穴。

scripts.text: It looks like your help could be useful after all. It's time for you to pitch in. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 看來你的幫助確實派上用場了。是時候讓你大顯身手了。祝你好運。

scripts.text: Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 50 Glacial Hearts, 50.
scripts.translation: 嗯... 你沒聽到我說的話嗎？我說的是50個冰塊心臟，50個。

scripts.text: Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!
scripts.translation: 現在快點去吧。如果你想放棄，沒關係。但請告訴我！

scripts.text: I guess you'd benefit from a full situational briefing. Shall I brief you now?
scripts.translation: 看來你需要一份完整的情報簡報。現在為你簡報嗎？

scripts.text: I'm going to tell you some basic information about fighting Satan Morocc as a member of the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation: 我將向你介紹作為皇家衛士成員，對抗魔王夢羅克的一些基本資訊。

scripts.text: Do you remember what Morocc was like before this happened? You would if you've been here before.
scripts.translation: 你還記得事情發生前夢羅克的樣子嗎？如果你之前來過這裡，應該記得。

scripts.text: Right now, all of Morocc's entrances and the outer fields leading to other villages are currently under our control.
scripts.translation: 目前，夢羅克的所有入口以及通往其他村莊的外圍區域，都在我們的控制之下。

scripts.text: The main reason for this is because Satan Morocc has been sighted in Sograt Desert, but there's another important reason.
scripts.translation: 主要原因是魔王夢羅克在蘇克拉特沙漠被目擊到了，但還有另一個重要原因。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc's power has been causing unnatural gaps in our time-space continuum. The gaps are isolated to this area for now, but we can't be sure if they'll spread.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克的力量正在我們的時空連續體中造成不自然的裂隙。目前這些裂隙僅限於該區域，但我們無法確定它們是否會擴散。

scripts.text: Due to the time-space gaps, Sograt Desert's terrain has changed, and some parts of the desert have disappeared.
scripts.translation: 由於時空裂隙，蘇克拉特沙漠的地形發生了變化，沙漠的部分割槽域已經消失。

scripts.text: Furthermore, the situation's gotten worse since Satan Morocc's doppelgangers started appearing, and other monsters have become influenced by its power.
scripts.translation: 此外，自從魔王夢羅克的分身開始出現以來，情況變得更加糟糕，其他魔物也受到了其力量的影響。

scripts.text: That's all we know so far. If you go out, you'll see what I mean... You may even see horrors that we haven't discovered yet. If you need more information, please speak to the Continental Official.
scripts.translation: 目前我們只知道這些。你出去看看就明白我的意思了...甚至可能會看到我們尚未發現的恐怖景象。如果需要更多情報，請去找皇家衛士官員。

scripts.text: Please do your best to hold back Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands. Dismissed.
scripts.translation: 請盡力阻止魔王夢羅克。別忘了，大陸的未來掌握在我們手中。解散。

scripts.text: I see. Keep up your good work in fighting Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands.
scripts.translation: 明白了。繼續在對魔王夢羅克的戰鬥中保持出色的表現。別忘了，大陸的未來掌握在我們手中。

scripts.text: Wah... What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation: 哇... 什麼？你真的擊敗了魔王夢羅克？

scripts.text: How? Do you have any proof of your victory?
scripts.translation: 怎麼做到的？你有勝利的證據嗎？

scripts.text: ...No, I can't just accept and trust your verbal account. I mean, if you've completed such an important mission, you must bring me some evidence.
scripts.translation: ...不，我不能僅憑你的口頭陳述就接受並相信。我是說，如果你完成了如此重要的任務，必須給我一些證據。

scripts.text: Go back, bring proof of your victory, and then come back.
scripts.translation: 回去，帶上你勝利的證據，然後再回來。

scripts.text: What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation: 什麼？你真的擊敗了魔王夢羅克？

scripts.text: How? Do you have any proof of your victory?
scripts.translation: 怎麼做到的？你有勝利的證據嗎？

scripts.text: Wow... I think this is really the skin of Satan Morocc. Congratulations, soldier. You just saved this world and people from being consumed by destruction and evil.
scripts.translation: 哇...我想這確實是魔王夢羅克的皮。恭喜你，士兵。你剛剛拯救了這個世界和人民，使他們免於被毀滅和邪惡吞噬。

scripts.text: I guess you seriously wounded Satan Morocc, and it retreated to a time-space gap. No doubt it's trying to recoup its strength.
scripts.translation: 看來你嚴重擊傷了魔王夢羅克，它撤退到了時空裂隙中。毫無疑問，它正在試圖恢復力量。

scripts.text: My only regret is that we can't pursue Morocc beyond this dimension. I'm glad, however, that you defeated Satan Morocc and kept it from regaining its full strength. For now, anyway...
scripts.translation: 我唯一的遺憾是我們無法跨越這個維度去追擊夢羅克。不過，我很高興你擊敗了魔王夢羅克，阻止了它恢復全部力量。至少暫時是這樣...

scripts.text: Our researchers might be able to learn some important new facts from this piece of skin... We need to learn all we can about that monster if peace is to be possible in our world's future.
scripts.translation: 我們的研究員或許能從這塊皮上了解到一些重要的新事實...如果我們要在未來實現和平，就必須儘可能多地瞭解那個魔物。

scripts.text: Once again, I thank you for your distinguished service on behalf of the Continental Guard and the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. I'll report your great achievement to His Majesty right away.
scripts.translation: 再次感謝你在皇家衛士和盧恩·米德加茲王國服役期間的傑出表現。我會立刻向陛下彙報你的偉大成就。

scripts.text: I've prepared a few things to give as a reward for you. Let's see... I have three items. Which one do you like to receive?
scripts.translation: 我準備了一些東西作為給你的獎勵。讓我看看...我有三件物品。你想領取哪一件？

scripts.text: The Seal of Continental Guard is an extremely valuable reward given directly from the kingdom court. It is a symbol of strength.
scripts.translation: 皇家衛士的徽章是由王國宮廷直接頒發的極其珍貴的獎勵。它是力量的象徵。

scripts.text: The accessory's options are: ^0000FF MHP+50, +3% Attack Speed^000000.
scripts.translation: 該飾品的屬性為： 最大^0000FFHP+50，攻擊速度+^0000003%。

scripts.text: Do you really want the Seal of Continental Guard?
scripts.translation: 你確定要領取皇家衛士的徽章嗎？

scripts.text: Great, then I'll reward you with the Seal of Continental Guard. Congratulations.
scripts.translation: 很好，那麼我將把皇家衛士的徽章作為獎勵給你。恭喜你。

scripts.text: I hope you keep in mind that our battle is far from over. Our enemy is the king of demons... I fear that Satan Morocc will return someday soon.
scripts.translation: 我希望你記住，我們的戰鬥還遠未結束。我們的敵人是惡魔之王...我擔心魔王夢羅克很快就會捲土重來。

scripts.text: Enjoy your victory, but be ever watchful and vigilant. I will always be here to help and reward you for your service.
scripts.translation: 享受你的勝利吧，但請時刻保持警惕。我會一直在這裡，為你的服務提供幫助和獎勵。

scripts.text: You should go rest now. Don't worry, we'll take care of everything else here.
scripts.translation: 你現在應該去休息了。別擔心，這裡的一切我們會處理好的。

scripts.text: No problem. Take your time to think, and then speak to me again.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。請慢慢考慮，然後再來與我對話。

scripts.text: I've heard that the kingdom is planning to send out a large group of researchers to investigate the other world to which Satan Morocc has escaped.
scripts.translation: 我聽說王國正計劃派遣一支龐大的研究員隊伍，去調查魔王夢羅克逃往的那個異世界。

scripts.text: That means it's time for both of us -- you and I -- to get to work. Who knows when Morocc will return to plague us?
scripts.translation: 這意味著我們——你和我——是時候開始行動了。誰知道夢羅克何時會回來禍害我們？

scripts.text: Please keep up the good work, and don't forget that the future of the continent and the kingdom relies on us.
scripts.translation: 請繼續保持出色的表現，別忘了大陸和國家的未來都繫於我們身上。

scripts.text: You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation: 您來得不是時候，但很高興見到您。我是皇家衛士的巴洛格隊長。我們被派往夢羅克以鎮壓魔王夢羅克...我們需要聚集所有能找到的力量和運氣。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy checking through all these applications for future Continental Guards to greet you adventurers one by one.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙著稽核這些未來皇家衛士的申請，沒空逐一問候各位冒險者。

scripts.text: Listen, it might be more helpful if you talk to some other people first. I'm sure one of the other Continental Guards or our messengers will be better equipped to help you out.
scripts.translation: 聽著，也許先和其他人聊聊會更有幫助。我相信其他皇家衛士成員或我們的信使能更好地為您提供幫助。

scripts.text: Awed by the time-space gap where darkness is given life, you instinctively step back.
scripts.translation: 面對那賦予黑暗以生命的時空裂隙，你感到敬畏，本能地退後了一步。

scripts.text: You can feel the power of the darkness rise from the gap where light and darkness are mingled.
scripts.translation: 你能感覺到黑暗的力量從光與暗交織的裂隙中升起。

scripts.text: The time-space gap's frightening darkness seems to dissipate as Satan Morocc fades away.
scripts.translation: 隨著魔王夢羅克的身影消散，時空裂隙中那令人恐懼的黑暗似乎也漸漸散去。

scripts.text: You can see the fragments floating in the gap, and the radiating lights are now slowing their movement.
scripts.translation: 你能看到碎片在裂隙中漂浮，那些放射出的光芒現在也減緩了移動。

scripts.text: You stretch your hand and pick up a lusterless fragment.
scripts.translation: 你伸出手，撿起了一塊黯淡無光的碎片。

scripts.text: Slowly, erratically, the mysterious curtain of darkness casts over your eyes as you stare at the time-space gap.
scripts.translation: 當你凝視著時空裂隙時，那神秘的黑幕緩慢而雜亂地籠罩了你的雙眼。

scripts.text: You feel like it's too dangerous to come any closer.
scripts.translation: 你覺得再靠近太危險了。

scripts.translation: 請輸入我們常唱的那些數字。

scripts.text: ^660000Morocc, the City of the Desert, has been completely devastated by Satan Morocc.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000沙漠之城夢羅克，已被魔王夢羅克徹底摧^000000毀。

scripts.text: ^660000The people of Morocc were resilient enough to endure the region's harsh weather, but their toughness to the weather could not prepare them enough as they witnessed the destruction brought down upon the city by Satan Morocc.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000夢羅克的居民早已習慣當地惡劣的氣候，但即便如此，也無法承受魔王夢羅克摧毀城市的景象^000000。

scripts.text: ^660000This man, who looks as dry and thin as a fish dried up under the sun, still has a smile that reminds you of a benevolent god, and is touching a book in his hand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這個看起來像被太陽曬乾的魚一樣乾瘦的男人，臉上仍帶著讓你想起仁慈神明的微笑，正撫摸著他手中的^000000書。

scripts.text: ^660000Watching him makes you giggle, he looks no better than the dried corpses in the pyramid, but he is obviously alive and doesn't appear to be a monster. Somehow, you find yourself compelled to approach this interesting looking man.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000看著他讓你忍不住發笑，他看起來不比金字塔裡的乾屍好多少，但他顯然還活著，也不像是魔物。不知為何，你發現自己被這個看起來很有趣的男人吸引，想要靠近^000000他。

scripts.text: Your healthy golden skin is glowing under the blessed sunlight of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 你健康的金色肌膚，在夢羅克神聖的陽光下閃閃發光。

scripts.text: Your smile outshines the aura of the gods of Valhalla. You are a living gospel. Your smile even makes Goddess Freya hide in the shadows in shame! Ah.... Mammi, my Mammi!
scripts.translation: 你的笑容比英靈殿眾神的光輝還要耀眼。你是一本活生生的福音書，你的笑容甚至讓女神芙蕾雅都羞愧地躲進陰影裡！啊...麻米，我的麻米！

scripts.text: ^660000You wave your hand close to his face to get his attention. He seems, however, to be in his own dreams, completely oblivious of your presense.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你在他的臉前揮了揮手，試圖引起他的注意。然而，他似乎沉浸在自己的夢境中，完全沒察覺到你的存^000000在。

scripts.text: Wah! Oh, my god, you must be a messenger of the devil trying to interrupt me from feeling Mammi!
scripts.translation: 哇！天哪，你一定是惡魔派來的信使，想打斷我感受麻米的存在！

scripts.text: I'm not afraid of you, so bring it on!
scripts.translation: 我才不怕你呢，放馬過來吧！

scripts.text: ^660000Surprised by your voice, he yelled at you, which seemed bizarre.
scripts.translation: ^660000他被你的聲音嚇了一跳，衝你大喊大叫，看起來有些奇怪。

scripts.text: You wonder what he meant by feeling her when he was just watching and touching a book.^000000
scripts.translation: 你想知道他剛才只是看著書、摸著書，為什麼說要“感受”^000000她。

scripts.text: What? Don't you know Mammi, one of the three greatest Rune-Midgarts' idols?
scripts.translation: 什麼？你不知道麻米嗎？她是盧恩·米德加茲三大偶像之一啊！

scripts.text: Man, you don't know anything, do you?! Well, judging by the stupid look on your face, I guess you're an adventurer running around on meaningless errands for others. Heh heh!
scripts.translation: 天哪，你什麼都不知道是吧？！看你這副蠢樣，我猜你就是個替別人跑腿、做無意義差事的冒險者吧。嘿嘿!！

scripts.text: ^660000Umm... You now regret speaking to him in the first place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000嗯...你現在後悔剛才跟他搭話^000000了。

scripts.text: My Mammi is different from those other celebrities that only rely on their beauty and lack any real substance.
scripts.translation: 我的麻米和其他那些只靠美貌、毫無內涵的名人不同。

scripts.text: She always carries books with her despite her hectic schedule. That alone should tell you that she's more intelligent than all the others! Ah... Mammi...
scripts.translation: 儘管行程繁忙，她總是隨身攜帶書籍。光這一點就足以證明她比其他人聰明多了！啊...麻米...

scripts.text: She even mentioned in an interview in 'Morocc Times' that she wants to meet a man that loves books.
scripts.translation: 她甚至在《夢羅克時報》的採訪中說，想見一個愛書的人。

scripts.text: That means... She's waiting for someone like me. Hehehe!
scripts.translation: 也就是說...她在等像我這樣的人。嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text: You see, every book in Rune-Midgarts' Library has the name Benjamin written on them... That's me!
scripts.translation: 你看，盧恩·米德加茲圖書館裡的每本書上都寫著本傑明的名字...那就是我！

scripts.text: ^660000This Benjamin seems to be a huge fan of a female celebrity called Mammi. He didn't shut his mouth and worshipped her beauty for a while, but then he suddenly stopped and looked depressed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這個本傑明顯然是女性名人“麻米”的超級粉絲。他滔滔不絕地讚美了她的美貌，過了一會兒突然停了下來，神情變得沮^000000喪。

scripts.text: My Mammi said that she's fallen in love with a book written by ^FF0000'Oliver Hilpert'^000000 of Schwarzwald: ^FF0000'The Crow of the Fate,'^000000 but I didn't have a chance of even looking at it!
scripts.translation: 我的麻米說，她愛上了秀髮茲發德^FF0000的奧利弗·希^000000爾佩特寫的^FF0000《命運的烏鴉》^000000，但我連看一眼的機會都沒有！

scripts.text: Unless you're blind, you know how terrible Morocc is nowadays.
scripts.translation: 除非你是瞎子，否則你知道現在的夢羅克有多糟糕。

scripts.text: I really need to read that book and tell her that I'm here for her, but I don't even have the time to regain my breath because of this situation in our hands!
scripts.translation: 我真的必須讀那本書，告訴她我就在她身邊，但眼下的局勢讓我連喘口氣的時間都沒有！

scripts.text: My Mammi pillow cover is buried under debris... Gasp!
scripts.translation: 麻米的枕套被埋在瓦礫下面...喘不過氣來了！

scripts.text: Mammi, I'm coming! Don't you die yet!
scripts.translation: 麻米，我來了！求求你，別死掉！

scripts.text: ^660000He seems to see an image of Mammi, and he shouted her name, gasping with anxiety. You feel so sorry for his agony.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他似乎看到了麻米的幻象，焦慮地喘息著，大聲呼喚著她的名字。你為他的痛苦感到十分難^000000過。

scripts.text: ^660000He inhaled deeply, and then suddenly turned his head toward you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他深吸了一口氣，然後突然轉過頭看向了^000000你。

scripts.text: You look bored. You must be waiting for someone to give you something to do!
scripts.translation: 你看起來很無聊。一定是在等有人給你派活吧！

scripts.text: Help me connect with Mammi. Who knows? I may let you have a conversation with Mammi, whom everyone in Rune-Midgarts adores.
scripts.translation: 幫我聯絡一下麻米。說不定...我會讓你和麻米聊聊天，你知道的，盧恩·米德加茲所有人都愛慕她。

scripts.text: ^660000Didn't you just call me an adventurer that runs around on meaningless errands for others...?^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你剛才不是還說我是一個到處幫人跑腿做無意義雜事的冒險者嗎..^000000.？

scripts.text: All I'm asking is to check out a book from Prontera Library for me. It sounds easy, doesn't it?
scripts.translation: 我只是想讓你去普隆德拉圖書館幫我借一本書。聽起來很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text: Well, you don't look like someone who loves reading, but I hope you at least know how to check out a book from a library.
scripts.translation: 雖然你看起來不像個愛讀書的人，但我希望你至少知道怎麼從圖書館借書。

scripts.text: If you help me, I'll show you a limited picture book edition of Mammi... Once. Hehehehe.
scripts.translation: 如果你幫我的話，我就給你看麻米的限量版寫真集...只看一次哦。嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text: What do you say? You do want to help me, right?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？你肯定想幫我的，對吧？

scripts.text: If you help me, I'll show you a limited picture book edition of Mammi... Once. Hehehehe.
scripts.translation: 如果你幫我的話，我就給你看麻米的限量版寫真集...只看一次哦。嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text: So, aren't you interested in looking at another girl's pictures? Umm, if you want, I can introduce you to a handsome guard in Morocc...
scripts.translation: 所以，你對看別的女生的照片不感興趣嗎？嗯，如果你願意的話，我也可以介紹你認識夢羅克的一位英俊衛兵...

scripts.text: What do you say? You do want to help me, right?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？你肯定想幫我的，對吧？

scripts.text: Wow, are you really going to help me?
Thank you so much! Then remember this title: 'The Crow of the Fate' written by 'Oliver Hilpert.' I'm sure you can find it in Prontera Library.
scripts.translation: 太感謝了！那麼請記住這個書名：奧利弗·希爾佩特寫的《命運的烏鴉》。我確信你在普隆德拉圖書館能找到它。
嘿嘿嘿，麻米！我快成功了！

scripts.text: What, don't you know how to check out a book from a library? Oh, my...
scripts.translation: 什麼，你不知道怎麼從圖書館借書嗎？哎呀...

scripts.text: Don't you forget this title: 'The Crow of the Fate' written by 'Oliver Hilpert.' I'm sure you can find it in Prontera Library.
scripts.translation: 別忘記這個書名：奧利弗·希爾佩特寫的《命運的烏鴉》。我確信你在普隆德拉圖書館能找到它。

scripts.text: ^660000Just like the last time that you saw him, Bejamin is living in his dreams, rubbing a book on his face.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000就像上次見到他時一樣，本傑明沉浸在他的幻想中，把書貼在臉上摩^000000擦。

scripts.text: ^660000You carefully approached him, and then gave him a pat on the shoulder.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你小心翼翼地靠近他，然後拍了拍他的肩^000000膀。

scripts.text: Who dares interrupt me from feeling Mammi? Do you want a piece of me... Err?
scripts.translation: 誰敢打斷我和麻米的親密接觸？你想嚐嚐我的厲害嗎...嗯？

scripts.text: Gosh, it's you. What took you so long? Wasn't Prontera Library, like, five minutes away?
scripts.translation: 啊，原來是你。怎麼花了這麼久？普隆德拉圖書館離這裡不是隻有五分鐘路程嗎？

scripts.text: Ahchoo! Thanks to you, I couldn't find it from the library. So I travelled all the way up to Schwarzwald... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation: 阿嚏！多虧了你，我在圖書館找不到那本書。所以我一路跑到了秀髮茲發德...阿嚏！

scripts.text: ^660000Feeling angry at him, you exaggerated a fit of sneezing which you have had for quite a while.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你對他感到生氣，於是誇張地打了一個你一直有的噴^000000嚏。

scripts.text: Hehehe, you're more reliable than I thought. Thanks for the book... Wait, does that mean I have to go up to Schwarzwald to return this? Man!
scripts.translation: 呵呵呵，你比我想像的更可靠。謝謝你的書...等等，這難道意味著我要去秀髮茲發德還書嗎？天哪！

scripts.text: ...No, I can do anything as long as it's for Mammi. Heh heh, you're a kind adventurer. Thanks.
scripts.translation: ...不，只要是為了麻米，我什麼都願意做。嘿嘿，你真是個善良的冒險者。謝謝。

scripts.text: Was it cold up there? I guess it is since Schwarzwald is located up north from here.
scripts.translation: 那裡冷嗎？我想應該很冷，因為秀髮茲發德位於這裡的北方。

scripts.text: Let me think. If this book is not yet available in Prontera Library, it must mean that not many people of Rune-Midgarts have read this book.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想。如果普隆德拉圖書館還沒有這本書，那就意味著盧恩·米德加茲沒多少人讀過這本書。

scripts.text: Grrrr... Mammi! Here I am, following your noble tastes to read such a rare book! Mammi...!
scripts.translation: 嘎吱...麻米！我為了追隨你高貴的品味，竟然去讀這麼稀有的書！麻米...！

scripts.text: I feel so excited to think about having a deep conversation with Mammi about literature! Yay!
scripts.translation: 一想到能和麻米深入探討文學，我就好興奮！耶！

scripts.text: I should go read this book right away. Hehehe!
scripts.translation: 我得馬上去讀這本書。呵呵呵！

scripts.text: Oops, I must not forget to repay you. You know, I'm a polite man.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我不能忘記報答你。你知道的，我是個有禮貌的人。

scripts.text: Look, it's the picture book of Mammi I told you about.
scripts.translation: 看，這就是我告訴過你的麻米寫真集。

scripts.text: Ah... Look at this picture of her wearing the rolled-up puppy ears! Doesn't she look like a sad puppy wandering Comodo, the City of Lovers, all by herself?!
scripts.translation: 啊...看看這張她戴著卷卷小狗耳朵的照片！她看起來是不是像一隻在克魔島——這座戀人之城——獨自遊蕩的悲傷小狗？！

scripts.text: How could no one shed a tear after watching this sad picture of her?! Argh, Mammi! I'm coming to make you the happiest woman in the world!
scripts.translation: 看完這張悲傷的照片，怎麼會有人不流淚呢？啊，麻米！我要去讓你成為世界上最幸福的女人！

scripts.text: 'She looks different than I thought with these glasses and pony tails... She really looks like someone who loves literature.
scripts.translation: ‘她戴著這副眼鏡和馬尾辮，看起來和我想像的不太一樣...她真的很像熱愛文學的人。

scripts.text: Wait, when did people start calling Comodo the City of Lovers? Hmm... This guy really thinks weird things!'
scripts.translation: 等等，什麼時候開始有人把克魔島稱為戀人之城了？嗯...這傢伙的想法真奇怪！”

scripts.text: I've decided to give you this <Angel Mammi's Special picture book: In Comodo> which is full of her beautiful pictures in return of your favor. Ahem... What do you say?
scripts.translation: 我決定把這本《天使麻米的特別寫真集：在克魔島》送給你，裡面全是她美麗的照片，作為對你幫助的回報。咳...你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: ^660000He is staring at you arrogantly. Obviously, he doesn't care if you like the book or not.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他傲慢地盯著你。顯然，他並不在乎你是否喜歡這本^000000書。

scripts.text: '^660000Well, if it's for free, and there's no harm keeping it.'^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000“既然是免費的，留著也沒什麼壞處^000000。’

scripts.text: No, thanks. I'm not interested in her as much as you.
scripts.translation: 不，謝謝。我對她沒你那麼感興趣。

scripts.text: ...^660000Was what you were about to say, but you could not refuse his offer. Looking at his fanatical eyes, burning with love for her, even Odin could not refuse...^000000
scripts.translation: .^660000..這是你原本想說的話，但你無法拒絕他的提議。看著他眼中燃燒著對她的愛意的狂熱眼神，即使是奧丁也無法拒絕.^000000..

scripts.text: ^660000Quickly blinking his eyes, he made you take Mammi's picture book in your arms
scripts.translation: ^660000他眨了眨眼，強行將麻米的寫真集塞進你懷裡，

scripts.text: demanding that you must encase the book so it would not be damaged.^000000
scripts.translation: 並要求你必須好好保護這本書，絕不能讓它受^000000損。

scripts.text: Oh, right. If you're interested in this author, Oliver Hilpert, I suggest you read the prequel of <The Crow of the Fate>, ^3131FF<The Trace of the Fate>^000000 as well as the sequel.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了。如果你對這位作者奧利弗·希爾佩特感興趣，我建議你同時也讀一讀《命運^3131FF的烏鴉》的前傳《命運^000000的痕跡》以及續集。

scripts.text: Now I need to start reading this book for the moment that I'll meet my Mammi, so please leave me alone.
scripts.translation: 現在我得開始讀這本書了，為了迎接與麻米見面的那一刻，請讓我一個人靜靜。

scripts.text: ^660000As soon as he finished, he returned to escaping reality by indulging himself in his dreams of Mammi.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000話音剛落，他便沉浸在關於麻米的幻想中，逃避著現^000000實。

scripts.text: Well, I don't have anything else to do. I might want to read the book...^000000
scripts.translation: 反正我也沒什麼事做。也許我可以去讀讀那本書.^000000..

scripts.text: Wait, does it mean that I have to go back to Juno Library?
scripts.translation: 等等，這難道意味著我得回朱諾圖書館嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000Thinking of travelling back to Juno made you sigh in frustration.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000一想到要返回朱諾，你便沮喪地嘆了口^000000氣。

scripts.text: ^660000You have embarked on a journey to Juno to read the prequel of <The Crow of the Fate>: <The Trace of the Fate>.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你踏上了前往朱諾的旅程，去閱讀《命運的烏鴉》的前傳：《命運的痕跡^000000》。

scripts.text: I've got the perfect thing to help you appeal to Mammi. Do you want to see?
scripts.translation: 我找到了一個能幫你打動麻米的完美東西。你想看看嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000You have shown him an autograph and a written note by Oliver Hilpert.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你向他展示了奧利弗·希爾佩特的親筆簽名和留^000000言。

scripts.text: These will surely help me get closer to Mammi!
scripts.translation: 這些肯定能幫我離麻米更近一步！

scripts.text: I'm going to see her tomorrow as soon as the morning comes! Mammi, I'm coming!
scripts.translation: 明天一早我就去見她！麻米，我來了！

scripts.text: Huh? What, are you kidding me?
With dreamy eyes, the man is looking down at a book in his hand.
scripts.translation: 男子眼神迷離，低頭看著手中的書。

scripts.text: Our library's Monster Encyclopedia has every monster in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom categorized by dungeon, to help our readers find them easily.
scripts.translation: 我們圖書館的《魔物圖鑑》收錄了盧恩·米德加茲王國所有的魔物，並按地下城分類，方便讀者查詢。

scripts.text: We also have many essential books for adventurers. Why don't you take a look?
scripts.translation: 這裡還有許多對冒險者來說必不可少的書籍。要不要去看看？

scripts.text: The other library across the street also has Monster Encyclopedias.
scripts.translation: 街對面的那家圖書館也有《魔物圖鑑》。

scripts.text: If you're interested, feel free to drop by that library as well.
scripts.translation: 如果您感興趣，也歡迎去那裡看看。

scripts.text: Do you have a specific book in mind?
No problem, I'm here to assist you.
scripts.translation: 沒問題，我很樂意為您效勞。

scripts.text: What kind of book are you looking for?
Oh, do you know the title?
Hmm... I'm sorry. I've worked at this place for a few decades, but I don't think I've ever seen such a book.
scripts.translation: 嗯...抱歉。我在這裡工作了幾十年，但我覺得我從未見過這樣的書。

scripts.text: Oh, do you know the author?
Hmm... I'm sorry. I've worked at this place for a few decades, but I don't think I've ever heard of such an author.
scripts.translation: 嗯...抱歉。我在這裡工作了幾十年，但我覺得我從未聽說過這樣的作者。

scripts.text: You must be having a hard time remembering the book's title or author.
scripts.translation: 您一定很難記住書名或作者吧。

scripts.text: No problem; why don't you tell me at least a little bit of what you remember?
scripts.translation: 沒關係，您至少能告訴我您記得的一些細節嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm... I'm sorry. I've worked at this place for a few decades, but I don't think I've ever seen a book whose name is even close to the words you said.
scripts.translation: 嗯...抱歉。我在這裡工作了幾十年，但我覺得我從未見過名字與您所說詞語相近的書。

scripts.text: Oh, right! I think I know the book:
scripts.translation: 哦，對了！我想我知道那本書：

scripts.text: That's right! That's what I'm looking for!
scripts.translation: 沒錯！就是我要找的那本！

scripts.text: Haha... But I have bad news for you.
The book has become so popular that you can't even find it from Schwarzwald, the author's country.
scripts.translation: 這本書太受歡迎了，甚至在作者所在的秀髮茲發德都買不到了。

scripts.text: We tried to get a hold of the book, but it was too late. It'll take a while for the next editon to be published, so why don't you read a different book for now?
scripts.translation: 我們曾試圖獲取這本書，但為時已晚。下一版出版還需要一段時間，您現在不妨先讀讀別的書？

scripts.text: If you are not busy and really want to read the book, I have a suggestion: try Juno Library.
scripts.translation: 如果您不忙且真的想讀這本書，我有一個建議：試試朱諾圖書館。

scripts.text: You can find every book published in Schwarzwald from the library. Chances are, you'll find it there.
scripts.translation: 那裡有秀髮茲發德出版的所有書籍。您很可能在那裡找到它。

scripts.text: Well, Juno is quite far from here, but if you're really enthusiastic about reading such a popular book, it should be worthwile.
scripts.translation: 嗯，朱諾離這裡確實很遠，但如果您真的對這本熱門書籍如此熱衷，那也值得跑一趟。

scripts.text: ^660000The book isn't for you, but you believe in 100% customer satisfaction. Let's go to Juno Library now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這本書雖然不適合你，但我堅信百分之百的顧客滿意度。我們現在就去朱諾圖書館^000000吧。

scripts.text: Each book tells you a story of life, wisdom, happiness, and sensation.
scripts.translation: 每一本書都講述著關於生命、智慧、幸福與感動的故事。

scripts.text: Look around! They are the witnesses of mankind. And everyday, we have new ones joining them.
scripts.translation: 環顧四周！它們是人類歷史的見證者。而且每一天，都有新的書籍加入它們的行列。

scripts.text: You damn bird! Fly away, leave!

scripts.translation: ^660000一名男子也在圖書館門口大聲叫^000000嚷。

scripts.text: It's nothing, but there's a gigantic crow sitting on the roof of this library, crowing for at least a few hours now.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼大事，只是有一隻巨大的烏鴉坐在這座圖書館的屋頂上，已經叫了好幾個小時了。

scripts.text: I was trying to drive it away because... It feels ominous somehow.
scripts.translation: 我正試圖趕走它，因為...它讓我覺得有些不祥。

scripts.text: Go! Fly away, you damn bird! Leave!!
scripts.translation: 走！飛走，你這該死的鳥！滾開！！

scripts.text: ^660000You looked up, and found a huge crow sitting on the roof of the library as if it owned the place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你抬頭望去，發現一隻巨大的烏鴉正坐在圖書館的屋頂上，彷彿那裡是它的地^000000盤。

scripts.text: Leave! Gosh, it won't go away!
scripts.translation: 滾開！天哪，它怎麼還不走！

scripts.text: I'm afraid that creepy bird will scare away my patrons!
scripts.translation: 我擔心那隻詭異的鳥會把我的顧客嚇跑！

scripts.text: I said go away, you stupid bird!
^660000Hit by the pebble which the man threw, the crow quickly flew up into the air.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000被那名男子扔出的石子擊中，烏鴉迅速飛上了天^000000空。

scripts.text: ^660000But then it started flying above the roof in a circle, and looked even spookier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000但隨後它開始在屋頂上方盤旋，看起來更加詭異^000000了。

scripts.text: Grrr... Can't you just go away?!
scripts.translation: 嗚嗚... 你就不能走開嗎？！

scripts.text: ^660000He started yelling at the crow, but it didn't seem to care. Instead, it flew up a little higher.
scripts.translation: ^660000他開始對著烏鴉大喊，但烏鴉似乎毫不在意，反而飛得更高了。

scripts.text: Eventually he turned his head away from the crow, and gave up on driving it away. Then the dog stopped barking as well.^000000
scripts.translation: 最終他轉過頭不再理會烏鴉，放棄了驅趕它。這時，狗也停止了吠^000000叫。

scripts.text: ^660000You looked down on the ground, and then found a couple of feathers dropped from the crow when it was hit by the pebble.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你低頭看向地面，發現烏鴉被石子擊中時掉落了幾根羽毛^000000。

scripts.text: Wow, look at the size of these feathers. I guess such a huge crow needs big feathers to fly.
scripts.translation: 哇，這些羽毛真大。看來這麼大的烏鴉，確實需要大羽毛才能飛起來。

scripts.text: When I was young, I heard that bird feathers bring Odin's servants to bless their owner, and so many poets used them as bookmarks.
scripts.translation: 小時候我聽說，鳥羽毛能引來奧丁的僕從祝福持有者，所以很多詩人把它們當作書籤。

scripts.text: I used to have a small feather. I guess it's only natural that I've become a library master. Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 我小時候也有一根小羽毛。我想，我成為圖書館館長也是理所當然的吧。哈哈哈!！

scripts.text: You know the old saying, 'you can memorize Edda after 3 years of working at a library.'
scripts.translation: 你知道那句老話嗎：“在圖書館工作三年，就能背下《埃達》。

scripts.text: Why don't you keep one of the feathers? Who knows? It may bring you good luck.
scripts.translation: ”不如你留一根羽毛吧？說不定能給你帶來好運。

scripts.text: ^660000You picked up one of the big dark feathers from the ground.
scripts.translation: ^660000你從地上撿起了一根巨大的深色羽毛。

scripts.text: Looking at the lustrous feather somehow made you feel so happy, as if you had obtained treasure.^000000
scripts.translation: 看著這根光澤亮麗的羽毛，不知為何讓你感到無比快樂，彷彿獲得了珍寶一^000000般。

scripts.text: God bless you. Oh, did you catch cold?
scripts.translation: 神明保佑你。哦，你感冒了嗎？

scripts.text: You should take good care of yourself, especially if you're an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 你要好好照顧自己，尤其是作為一名冒險者。

scripts.text: ^660000You started feeling cold and began to shiver.^000000

scripts.text: Try to drink hot Jellopy broth mixed with honey. My mother used to make that for me whenever I caught cold.
scripts.translation: 試著喝點加了蜂蜜的熱傑勒比結晶湯。我母親以前每次我感冒時都會給我做這個。

scripts.text: I gurantee you that you'll get better quickly.
scripts.translation: 我保證你很快就會好起來。

scripts.text: ^660000He sounded sincere, but it doesn't sound like that kind of broth would even be effective...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他聽起來很真誠，但那種湯聽起來似乎並不怎麼有效.^000000..

scripts.text: I've read his <The Trace of the Fate> at least several times. I mean, that book is so captivating that I can never get tired of reading it.
scripts.translation: 我至少讀過好幾遍他的《命運的痕跡》。我是說，那本書太迷人了，我讀多少遍都看不膩。

scripts.text: Umm... The most impressive scene was... Err...
scripts.translation: 嗯...最讓我印象深刻的場景是...呃...

scripts.text: Excuse me, are you okay? I mean, you just kind of drifted off all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下，你沒事吧？我是說，你剛才突然好像走神了。
你看起來臉色有點蒼白。

scripts.text: Why don't you go inside and take a rest? Read <The Trace of the Fate> or something.
scripts.translation: 你不如進去休息一下？讀讀《命運的痕跡》什麼的。

scripts.text: You can find the book at the left bookshelf upstairs.
scripts.translation: 那本書在樓上的左邊書架上。

scripts.text: Haha, look. I've signed it as big as I could so that you can brag about this to your friends!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，看。我簽得儘可能大，這樣你就可以向朋友們炫耀了！

scripts.text: You know, I just wrote what I saw in my dream; I didn't know people would love my stories so much! It's very surprising to me.
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎，我只是把我在夢中看到的寫了下來；我不知道人們會這麼喜歡我的故事！這對我來說非常驚訝。

scripts.text: Yes, I've been having dreams that are so vivid, they feel like reality.
scripts.translation: 是的，我一直做著非常逼真的夢，感覺就像現實一樣。

scripts.text: I was told great writers usually find their inspiration from their dreams. I guess I was born to be one of them. Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 我聽說偉大的作家通常從夢中獲得靈感。我想我天生就是其中之一吧。哈哈哈!！

scripts.text: You felt something uncomfortable about this so-called dream. You wanted to understand the meaning of what you've seen while reading the book.
scripts.translation: 你對這個所謂的“夢”感到有些不安。你想理解你在書中看到的內容的含義。

scripts.text: If Oliver was dreaming exactly the same things as you, that might mean he and you are sharing dreams. Then again, you've discovered the cave village in the book actually exists.
scripts.translation: 如果奧利弗做的夢和你完全一樣，那可能意味著你們在共享夢境。再說，你發現書中的洞穴村實際上是存在的。

scripts.text: The hero Al was having dreams...
^660000You quickly turned your head following his eyes. There was nothing but your bag.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你順著他的目光迅速轉過頭去。那裡只有你的背^000000包。

scripts.text: Ah... Ahchoo! Mr. Hilpert, are you interested in my bag? It's just a simple bag I got from the Novice Training Grounds...
scripts.translation: 啊...阿嚏！希爾佩特先生，你對我的背包感興趣嗎？這只是我在新手修煉場買的一個普通背包...

scripts.text: I was looking at the thing shining under the cover of the bag!
scripts.translation: 我在看背包底下閃閃發光的東西！

scripts.text: ^660000You checked what the thing in your bag was, and it was...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你檢查了背包裡的東西，那是.^000000..

scripts.text: ^660000Yes, it was the picture book of Mammi, an idol whom Benjamin of Morocc insists to be one of the three greatest idols in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. That must be why Oliver is squealing in delight.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000是的，那是麻米的寫真集。麻米是夢羅克的貝尼明堅持認為盧恩·米德加茲王國最偉大的三位偶像之一。難怪奧利弗會興奮得尖叫起^000000來。

scripts.text: Ahchoo! Are you also a Mammi fan?
scripts.translation: 阿嚏！你也是麻米的粉絲嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me, where you can find another intelligent and beautiful woman like her?
scripts.translation: 告訴我，哪裡還能找到像她這樣既聰明又美麗的女性？

scripts.text: I believe she's the reincarnation of the Wisdom Goddess who was expelled to the Midgard Continent by jealous goddesses.
scripts.translation: 我相信她是智慧女神的轉世，那些嫉妒她的女神將她驅逐到了米德加爾特大陸。

scripts.text: ^660000Mammi seems to have a strange level of popularity that you can never understand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000麻米似乎擁有一種你無法理解的奇怪人氣^000000。

scripts.text: ^660000You have given him Mammi's picture book.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你把麻米的寫真集遞給了^000000他。

scripts.text: Ah... This is why I'm in love with Lady Mammi.
scripts.translation: 啊...這就是我愛上麻米女士的原因。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you must be an enthusiastic fan of her as well. Where did you find this rare picture book?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你一定也是她的狂熱粉絲。你在哪裡找到這本稀有的寫真集的？

scripts.text: No, I got it as a gift from someone... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation: 不，這是別人送給我的禮物...阿嚏！

scripts.text: It's shocking to see you unimpressed by the beauty of Lady Mammi,
scripts.translation: 我現在很震驚！看到你竟然對麻米女士的美貌無動於衷，

scripts.text: but it is more shocking that God has given such a rare picture book of her
scripts.translation: 這很令人震驚，但更令人震驚的是，

scripts.text: to someone like you who does not appreciate its value!
scripts.translation: 神明竟然把這麼稀有的寫真集送給了一個不珍惜它價值的人！

scripts.text: I flew over to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom on the earliest airship
scripts.translation: 我坐最早一班飛空艇趕到盧恩·米德加茲王國，

scripts.text: to get this book on the day it was released, but the books were sold out. The person right in front of me got the last one!
scripts.translation: 想在發售當天買到這本書，但書已經賣光了。排在我前面的人買走了最後一本！

scripts.text: If you don't really like that book, why don't you sell it to me?
scripts.translation: 如果你真的不喜歡那本書，為什麼不賣給我呢？

scripts.text: As I told you earlier, it's something I'm willing to cross continents to get. Please?
scripts.translation: 正如我之前所說，這是我願意跨越大陸也要得到的東西。拜託了？

scripts.text: I really want to buy your book!
scripts.translation: 我真的非常想買下你的書！

scripts.text: Umm... I haven't received my publishing advance yet, but do you mind taking this instead?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我還沒收到出版預付款，你介意先收下這個嗎？

scripts.text: I haven't had a chance to open it, but my publisher said it has something very rare inside. I hope that it's enough to pay you for your book.
scripts.translation: 我還沒機會開啟它，但我的出版商說裡面有很稀有的東西。希望這足夠支付你那本書的費用。

scripts.text: You know, in Morocc... Ahchoo! ...There's someone who's as big a fan of Mammi's as you... Ahchoo! So why don't you go meet him?
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎，在夢羅克...阿嚏！...那裡有一個和你一樣喜歡麻米的人...阿嚏！所以你們為什麼不去見見他呢？

scripts.text: I got that book from him as a gift. He may have more rare books of her... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation: 那本書是他送給我的禮物。他可能還有更多她的稀有書籍...阿嚏！

scripts.text: Oh, thank you so much for such valuable information!
scripts.translation: 哦，非常感謝你提供這麼寶貴的資訊！

scripts.text: Wah! I must write down the story that I saw in my dream last night before I forget!
scripts.translation: 哇！我必須把昨晚夢裡看到的景象寫下來，不然就要忘了！

scripts.text: I hope you'll also like my next book. Then I must go... Thank you for the picture book!
scripts.translation: 希望你會喜歡我的下一本書。我得走了... 謝謝你的寫真集！

scripts.text: ^660000He started running around like a chicken with its head cut off. He quickly opened his bag, took out his notebook, ran to a table, and then started writing down something at a fast speed.
scripts.translation: ^660000他像只無頭小雞一樣到處亂跑。他迅速開啟背包，掏出筆記本，跑到一張桌子前，然後開始飛快地寫些什麼。

scripts.text: At first, he looked pretty silly, but now he strikes you as a man that's very serious about his writing.^000000
scripts.translation: 起初，他看起來有點傻，但現在你發現他是個對寫作非常認真的^000000人。

scripts.text: ^660000You were about to leave when you found a piece of paper on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你正要離開時，發現地上有一張紙^000000。

scripts.text: ^660000The piece of paper is covered with scribbles, and is labeled <The Crow of the Fate> at the top. Oliver must have dropped this note containing information about his novel, <The Crow of the Fate>.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那張紙上寫滿了塗鴉，頂部寫著<命運的烏鴉>。奧利弗一定是掉了這張包含他小說<命運的烏鴉>資訊的紙^000000條。

scripts.text: ^3131FFAncient weapon = Some kind of power source^000000
^3131FFThe stepmother = Lover from a past life?!^000000
^660000The book's cover was seriously damaged, considering its recent publishing date. Many people must have turned its pages.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000考慮到這本書的出版日期很近，它的封面卻破損得相當嚴重。一定有很多人翻閱過^000000它。

scripts.text: ^660000Startled by a terrifying scream, you regained consciousness. It seems that you were lost in time for quite a while.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000被一聲恐怖的尖叫驚醒，你恢復了意識。看來你在時間中迷失了相當長一段時^000000間。

scripts.text: ^660000You scrambled to stand on you feet, and then followed the sound of the scream to an old and abandoned building.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你慌忙站起身，循著尖叫聲來到一座古老廢棄的建築前^000000。

scripts.text: ^660000The old, huge and somehow intimidating building was expelling dark red smoke out of broken and open windows.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這座古老、巨大且透著幾分壓迫感的建築，正從破碎敞開的窗戶中冒出暗紅色的煙^000000霧。

scripts.text: ^660000While trying to remember what happened, you encounter a woman who passes by you. You instinctively reach for her shoulder to get her attention.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000當你試圖回憶剛才發生了什麼時，一位女子從你身邊經過。你本能地伸手抓住她的肩膀，試圖引起她的注^000000意。

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, your arm passed through her body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人驚訝的是，你的手臂直接穿過了她的身^000000體。

scripts.text: Argh... I can't breathe... I have to get out...
scripts.translation: 啊...我喘不過氣...我必須逃出去...

scripts.text: ^660000You walked through the flame engulfed hallway and ended at a room that was about to collapse, just like everywhere else in this place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你穿過被火焰吞噬的走廊，來到一間即將坍塌的房間，就像這裡其他地方一^000000樣。

scripts.text: ^660000You could not clearly see what was inside the room because of all the smoke, but you knew there was something there.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000由於煙霧瀰漫，你看不清房間裡的情況，但你知道那裡有東^000000西。

scripts.text: ^660000You squinted your eyes, and listened. You could hear human voices, but their silhouettes of whomever was talking were not human shaped.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你眯起眼睛，仔細聆聽。你能聽到人聲，但說話者的輪廓並非人形^000000。

scripts.text: ^660000Her coughing grew worse as the roaring of the flames grew stronger.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000隨著火焰的咆哮聲愈發強烈，她的咳嗽也愈發劇^000000烈。

scripts.text: They ran away, and left us behind to die!
scripts.translation: 他們逃走了，卻把我們留在這裡等死！

scripts.text: ^3131FF'Eva'^000000, we won't die... We were never exactly alive to begin with.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF伊娃，^000000我們不會死的...我們本來就不算活著。

scripts.text: ^660000The only exit was blocked by steel bars; no one could get out of the room enveloped in flames. Then, a corner of a wall crumbled by the heat from the fire.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000唯一的出口被鋼條封死，沒人能逃出這間被火焰包圍的房間。隨後，牆壁的一角因高溫而崩^000000塌。

scripts.text: ^660000The male silhouette quickly approached the wall, and started to dig at the crumbled corner.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那個男性的身影迅速靠近牆壁，開始挖掘崩塌的角^000000落。

scripts.text: Wait, we have to take the children with us.
scripts.translation: 等等，我們要帶上孩子們。

scripts.text: ^660000The female silhouette called Eva approached the test tubes standing in a row against a wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那個被稱為伊娃的女性身影走向靠牆排列的一排試^000000管。

scripts.text: Eva!! We don't have time to save all of them! Come here!
scripts.translation: 伊娃！！沒時間救所有人了！快過來！

scripts.text: ^660000Suddenly a flash of light stung your eyes. A few seconds later, you opened your eyes and found that you were somewhere in Schwarzwald.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000突然，一道強光刺痛了你的眼睛。幾秒後，你睜開眼，發現自己身處秀髮茲發^000000德。

scripts.text: ^660000And you aren't alone: you can now clearly see the man and woman that escaped the laboratory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000而且你並不孤單：你現在能清楚地看到那對從實驗室逃出來的男^000000女。

scripts.text: No one will welcome us... We look like monsters!
scripts.translation: 沒人會歡迎我們...我們看起來就像魔物！

scripts.text: I know a cave that's hidden in the north.
scripts.translation: 我知道北邊有個隱蔽的山洞。

scripts.text: We can stay there for a while.
scripts.translation: 我們可以先在那裡待一段時間。

scripts.text: ^660000They seemed completely oblivious of your presence, and headed north.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他們似乎完全沒察覺到你的存在，徑直向北走^000000去。

scripts.text: ^660000You were looking at their backs as they left, and then noticed that you were holding the book you were reading in your hands. Then....^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你望著他們離去的背影，然後注意到自己手裡正拿著剛才在讀的那本書。接著.^000000..

scripts.text: ^660000You wake up, and look around you. Somehow, you've now ended up in a huge mansion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你醒來，環顧四周。不知為何，你現在身處一座巨大的宅邸^000000中。

scripts.text: ^660000You suddenly feel a sharp pain in your chest, as if someone were squeezing your heart.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你突然感到胸口一陣劇痛，彷彿有人正在擠壓你的心^000000髒。

scripts.text: ^660000This mansion looks very elegant and expensive, but it is on fire, just like the laboratory in your first dream.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這座宅邸看起來非常優雅昂貴，但它正在燃燒，就像你第一個夢中的實驗室一^000000樣。

scripts.text: ^660000You're having trouble thinking because of your chest pain and the fire, but you know that this mansion won't last long. You look around for an exit, and see a man standing downstairs in the center of flames.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000胸口的疼痛和火焰讓你難以思考，但你知道這座宅邸撐不了多久。你四處尋找出口，看到樓下火焰中央站著一個男^000000人。

scripts.text: ^660000He didn't seem to care that he'd perish along with the mansion, and was talking slowly in a low, sad voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他似乎並不在意自己將與宅邸一同化為灰燼，只是用低沉而悲傷的聲音緩慢地訴說^000000著。

scripts.text: After all, God has trifled with me...
scripts.translation: 到頭來，神一直在戲弄我...

scripts.text: This was his plan all long...
Even my best friends were his puppets...
scripts.translation: 甚至我最親密的朋友也是他的傀儡...
我強烈地憎恨自己的命運...

scripts.text: But I'm ready to accept the end... Of everything...
scripts.translation: 但我已準備好接受終結... 一切的終結...

scripts.text: ^660000He could not finish his words before flames swallowed him up. At the same time, you were...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他沒能說完話，就被火焰吞沒了。與此同時，你.^000000..

scripts.text: Mother was... She was a regular human.
scripts.translation: 母親是... 她只是個普通的人類。

scripts.text: Was I standing next to her?
^660000He mumbled to himself, and brushed back his sweaty hair with a trembling hand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他喃喃自語，用顫抖的手撥開滿是汗水的頭^000000發。

scripts.text: I guess he won't be able to see or hear me, just like the others.
scripts.translation: 看來他和其他人一樣，既看不見也聽不到我。

scripts.text: ^660000You put your guard down, and stare at him.
Suddenly his face distorted in anger as he looked right back at you.^000000
scripts.translation: 突然，他轉過頭直視著你，臉上露出憤怒的神^000000情。

scripts.text: How the hell did you find me?!
scripts.translation: 你他媽是怎麼找到我的？！

scripts.text: ...Wah! He can see me! He can see me!
You don't have to be so angry at me, sir.
scripts.translation: 先生，您不必對我這麼生氣。

scripts.text: ^660000As soon as you heard her voice,
you turned around and found a woman standing there.^000000
scripts.translation: 你轉過身，發現那裡站著一個女^000000人。

scripts.text: It was almost done, but then you broke all of them -- even ^FF00FFBEEP^000000 and ^FF00FFBEEP^000000 -- and were hiding in here.
scripts.translation: 本來都快完成了，結果你卻把它們全毀^FF00FF了——^000000連嗶嗶和^FF00FF嗶嗶都^000000毀了——還躲在這裡。

scripts.text: They weren't supposed to exist in this world!
scripts.translation: 它們本不該存在於這個世界！

scripts.text: It's his decision. Your fate is on his...
scripts.translation: 這是他的決定。你的命運掌握在他...

scripts.text: ^660000The raging man drew a sword, and pointed it at her. She then suddenly transformed into a crow and flew away. The echos of her laughter could be heard outside the window.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000憤怒的男子拔出了劍，指向她。她突然變成一隻烏鴉飛走了。窗外還能聽到她笑聲的回^000000響。

scripts.text: You are bound to your fate, no matter how hard you try to escape...
scripts.translation: 無論你如何試圖逃避，你都註定要面對自己的命運...

scripts.text: No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
Hah, I knew you would be scared of me!
I have a goal to achieve in here... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation: 我有必須在這裡完成的目標...阿嚏！

scripts.text: ^660000Although you a bit intimidated by this guard, and your sneezing definitely not helping, you continue.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000雖然你被這個守衛的氣勢嚇到了，而且你的噴嚏也幫不上什麼忙，但你還是繼續前^000000行。

scripts.text: Are you kidding me? If you're looking for a missing child, go to the Juno police station!
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑嗎？如果你在找失蹤的孩子，去朱諾警察局！

scripts.text: Go upstairs, and tell Eva that she has a visitor.
scripts.translation: 上樓去，告訴伊娃有客人來了。

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, he seemed to know who Eva is. You still could not believe that she actually exists! It's all so very strange.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人驚訝的是，他似乎認識伊娃。你仍然不敢相信她真的存在！這一切都太奇怪^000000了。

scripts.text: ^660000You can feel the excitement and anticipation well within you. Maybe you're coming closer to learning what your dreams really mean.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你能感覺到內心湧起的興奮與期待。也許你正逐漸接近了解你夢境的真正含^000000義。

scripts.text: Hey, you can pass. Go upstairs, but you'd better think twice before trying anything funny. Do you understand me?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你可以過去了。上樓吧，但最好三思而後行，別耍什麼花樣。聽懂了嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000The stern-looking man examined you, and then stepped to the side, allowing you to pass.
scripts.translation: ^660000這位神情嚴肅的男子審視了你一番，然後讓開了路，讓你通過。

scripts.text: You clenched your fists in nervousness, and then started up the dark stairwell.^000000
scripts.translation: 你緊張地握緊了拳頭，然後開始走上昏暗的樓^000000梯。

scripts.text: No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
^660000His voice is as stern and intimidating as his appearance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的聲音和他的外表一樣，嚴厲而令人畏^000000懼。

scripts.text: Do you still have business with Zid?
You'd better finish it quickly because we don't like outsiders running around our village.
scripts.translation: 最好快點辦完，我們不喜歡外人在村子裡亂晃。

scripts.translation: ^660000雖然你被這位衛兵嚇得有些緊張，而且不停打噴嚏的狀況也沒幫你加分，但你還是繼續向^000000前。

scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑嗎？如果你在找失蹤的孩子，去朱諾警察局！

scripts.translation: 上樓去，告訴伊娃有客人來了。
