scripts.translation: ^660000你能感覺到內心湧起的興奮與期待。也許你正逐漸接近了解你夢境的真正含^000000義。

scripts.text: Hey, you can pass. Go upstairs, but you'd better think twice before trying anything funny. Do you understand me?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你可以過去了。上樓吧，但最好三思而後行，別耍什麼花樣。聽懂了嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000The stern-looking man examined you, and then stepped to the side, allowing you to pass.
scripts.translation: ^660000這位神情嚴肅的男子審視了你一番，然後讓開了路，讓你通過。

scripts.text: You clenched your fists in nervousness, and then started up the dark stairwell.^000000
scripts.translation: 你緊張地握緊了拳頭，然後開始走上昏暗的樓^000000梯。

scripts.text: No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
^660000His voice is as stern and intimidating as his appearance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的聲音和他的外表一樣，嚴厲而令人畏^000000懼。

scripts.text: ^660000You are looking at a man who appears as hideous as a monster.
scripts.translation: ^660000你正看著一個長相醜陋如魔物的男子。

scripts.text: He was the man with Eva that you saw in your dream. Of course, he's older now, and his age is showing in his face and skin.^000000
scripts.translation: 他正是你在夢中與伊娃在一起時見到的那個人。當然，他現在年紀大了，歲月在他臉上和皮膚上留下了^000000痕跡。

scripts.text: ^660000The pain in your chest suddenly hits you...
And your lungs seem much weaker from all of the coughing and sneezing you've suffered lately.^000000
scripts.translation: 最近頻繁的咳嗽和打噴嚏讓你的肺部似乎更加虛弱^000000了。

scripts.text: ^660000Rubbing your chest to ease the pain, you keep staring at him in surprise.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你揉著胸口試圖緩解疼痛，驚訝地凝視著^000000他。
我的長相讓你感到不適嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000He sounded weak, as if he did not have enough energy to talk.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的聲音很虛弱，彷彿沒有足夠的精力說^000000話。

scripts.text: Do you know a man by the name of Oliver Hilpert?
scripts.translation: 你認識一個叫奧利弗·希爾佩特的男人嗎？

scripts.text: Oliver? Well, I don't think so.
What does he have to do with anything?
scripts.translation: 他和這件事有什麼關係？

scripts.text: ^660000You have given him Oliver's novel, <The Crow of the Fate>, explaining strange events that have happened to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你把奧利弗的小說《命運的烏鴉》遞給他，並解釋了最近發生在你身上的奇怪事^000000件。

scripts.text: ^660000He squinted his eyes in curiosity and looked through a few pages of the book quietly. Then he opened his mouth as he handed the book back to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他好奇地眯起眼睛，安靜地翻看了幾頁書。然後他把書遞還給你，張開了嘴^000000。

scripts.text: I'm surprised that the story in this book is... It's similar to my life story. Very similar.
scripts.translation: 我很驚訝這本書裡的故事...它很像我的生平。非常像。

scripts.text: My name is Zid. Tell me what you want from me. I want to know more about this book.
scripts.translation: 我叫齊德。告訴我你想要什麼。我想知道更多關於這本書的事。

scripts.text: Did you notice that our villagers look different?
scripts.translation: 你注意到我們的村民看起來和常人不同嗎？

scripts.text: Human curiosity has led to great achievements and contributions, but there is a point where knowledge may be too much to handle.
scripts.translation: 人類的好奇心帶來了偉大的成就和貢獻，但知識有時也會多到讓人無法承受。

scripts.text: Everyone in this village is a runaway... We are victims of what happens when people play God, seek out forbidden knowledge, and toy with life.
scripts.translation: 這個村子裡的人都是逃亡者...我們是那些扮演神明、尋求禁忌知識、玩弄生命的實驗的受害者。

scripts.text: We have no choice but hide here because they are too powerful for us to speak out against... And we know that isn't right.
scripts.translation: 我們別無選擇，只能躲藏在這裡，因為他們太強大，我們無法發聲反抗...但我們知道這是不對的。

scripts.text: I was a normal man once, but poverty made me lose my pride, self-esteem, and identity.
scripts.translation: 我曾經是個普通人，但貧窮讓我失去了尊嚴、自尊和身份。

scripts.text: I was sick and tired of worrying about food everyday, and I volunteered to be a test subject in some experiment.
scripts.translation: 我厭倦了每天為食物發愁，於是自願成為某個實驗的受試者。

scripts.text: I no longer had to worry about starving, but my life as a 'human' ended that day.
scripts.translation: 我不再需要擔心捱餓，但在那一天，我作為“人類”的生活結束了。

scripts.text: At first, Eva and I were the only ones here, but others joined us, and we formed a small settlement.
scripts.translation: 起初，這裡只有伊娃和我，但後來其他人也加入了我們，我們形成了一個小型定居點。

scripts.text: Now I'm the oldest villager, and feel the heavy responsibility of protecting others.
scripts.translation: 現在我是村裡最年長的村民，感到保護他人的責任重大。

scripts.text: The laboratory in which Eva and I were being tested was not ordinary.
scripts.translation: 伊娃和我被測試的那個實驗室並不普通。

scripts.text: It was built to test and duplicate God's power of creation.
scripts.translation: 它是為了測試和複製神明創造生命的力量而建造的。

scripts.text: They failed to achieve their objective, and caused a series of unfortunate events
scripts.translation: 他們未能實現目標，並試圖操縱那些連檢查都困難的物質，

scripts.text: by trying to manipulate materials that were difficult to even examine.
scripts.translation: 導致了一系列不幸的事件。

scripts.text: They believed their research would open a whole new world for mankind...
scripts.translation: 他們相信他們的研究將為人類開啟一個全新的世界...

scripts.text: Eva was one of them... Although she wasn't kind, she at least sympathized for me because I sold myself out of poverty.
scripts.translation: 伊娃也是其中之一...她為人並不和善，但至少同情我這個因貧窮而把自己賣給實驗的人。

scripts.text: She had a man who loved her so much...
scripts.translation: 她有一個深愛她的男人...

scripts.text: His name was Sefakiest, and he always supported her research.
scripts.translation: 他的名字是塞法基斯特，他總是支援她的研究。

scripts.text: He... Killed himself in despair after Eva was turned into a mutant just like me... She wanted him to use her as his test subject.
scripts.translation: 他...在絕望中自殺了，因為伊娃像我一樣變成了變異體...她希望他把她當作他的受試者。

scripts.text: No one expected him to end his life so easily when he was the most enthusiastic researcher of all.
scripts.translation: 沒人預料到他會如此輕易地結束自己的生命，儘管他是所有研究員中最熱情的那一個。

scripts.text: Then somebody set the laboratory on fire. I assume you've seen that in your dream. The fire completely burned down the building.
scripts.translation: 然後有人放火燒了實驗室。我想你在夢中見過這一幕。大火將建築物完全燒燬。

scripts.text: Eva and I were able to escape before we could be found, and then settled down here. After all, we can't just mingle with ordinary humans.
scripts.translation: 伊娃和我在被發現之前逃了出來，然後在這裡定居下來。畢竟，我們不能和普通人類混在一起。

scripts.text: Eva managed to save one of the test subjects which actually grew up into a normal looking human, but he was actually perfect.
scripts.translation: 伊娃設法救下了一個受試者，他實際上長成了一個看起來正常的人類，但他其實是完美的。

scripts.text: That boy ran away when he was about 10. I guess he hit puberty... You know boys and girls at that age.
scripts.translation: 那個男孩在10歲左右逃跑了。我想他到了青春期...你知道那個年紀的男孩和女孩。

scripts.text: Eva couldn't forget him. She was waiting for his return inside this dark cave. For a while, he was sending letters without his address, but then they stopped coming. That's when Eva disappeared.
scripts.translation: 伊娃無法忘記他。她在這個黑暗的洞穴裡等待他的歸來。有一段時間，他寄來沒有地址的信，但後來信就斷了。就在那時，伊娃消失了。

scripts.text: I found ^3131FFa giant black feather^000000 in her room after she left.
scripts.translation: 她離開^3131FF後，我在她的房間裡發^000000現了一根巨大的黑色羽毛。

scripts.text: I don't know why, but... I believe Eva no longer exists...
scripts.translation: 我不知道為什麼，但...我相信伊娃已經不存在了...
也許奧利弗就是伊娃的那個男孩...

scripts.text: No, he's too young to be him because it happened a long time ago...
scripts.translation: 不，他太年輕了，不可能是他，因為那已經是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text: I guess it's just an old memory... Why should I care? Why should anyone?
scripts.translation: 我想那只是陳年舊事...我為什麼要在意？誰又會在意呢？

scripts.text: ^660000Zid stopped talking, and then lowered his head. After the pause, he opened his mouth again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000齊德不再說話，低下了頭。沉默片刻後，他再次開^000000口。

scripts.text: Now I'm too old to remember even Eva or the boy.
scripts.translation: 我現在太老了，連伊娃和那個男孩都記不清了。

scripts.text: My purpose in life is to protect the other villagers. They have lives ahead of them, living inside this dark cave.
scripts.translation: 我活著的意義就是保護其他村民。他們的人生還很漫長，即使只能在這黑暗的洞穴裡度過。

scripts.text: The book was interesting, but I'm sure that guy, Oliver, experienced the same thing that happened to you.
scripts.translation: 那本書很有趣，但我確信奧利弗那個傢伙，也經歷了和你一樣的事情。

scripts.text: Even if he has something to do with Eva, it's too late to do anything for her.
scripts.translation: 即使他和伊娃有關，現在想為她做點什麼也來不及了。

scripts.text: Think about it: who can save us from this dark cave, even if Eva or that boy is still alive? The answer is nobody.
scripts.translation: 想想看：即使伊娃或那個男孩還活著，誰能把我們救離這個黑暗的洞穴？答案是沒有人。

scripts.text: I'm so sorry for not being much help.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，我幫不上什麼忙。

scripts.text: You'd better wake up from the dream, and move on with your life.
scripts.translation: 你最好從夢中醒來，繼續你的生活。

scripts.text: ...Sadly everything is nothing but a dream...
scripts.translation: ...悲傷的是，這一切不過是一場夢...

scripts.text: If you really feel sorry for us, please do not let others know where we are.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的為我們感到難過，請不要讓其他人知道我們在哪裡。

scripts.text: ^660000Zid turned his head away from you. You're still not sure if all of this is really happening. It's all so surreal...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000齊德把頭扭向一邊。你仍然不確定這一切是否真的發生了。一切都太不真實了.^000000..

scripts.text: ^660000Frustrated by the conversation with Zid, you have decided to go back to Morocc and forget everything.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000對與齊德的對話感到沮喪，你決定回到夢羅克，忘掉這一^000000切。

scripts.text: Zid seemed to have lost his interest in the book.
scripts.translation: 齊德似乎對那本書失去了興趣。

scripts.text: You have decided to deliver the book to Benjamin of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 你決定把那本書交給夢羅克的本傑明。

scripts.text: No one in this village welcomes you. Go back.
scripts.translation: 這個村莊裡沒有人歡迎你。回去吧。

scripts.text: Your eyes are so tempting... I wanna eat them! Heh heh!
scripts.translation: 你的眼睛真誘人...我想吃掉它們！嘿嘿!！

scripts.text: Hoho, did he really say that yesterday...?
scripts.translation: 呵呵，他昨天真的那麼說了嗎...？
